source: PrivateVault's pv-delegation/2 scenarios (pv-delegation-2.json), built and verified with tenuo-ai/tenuo ietf/vectors/gen_vectors.py by tools/check_aat02_analogues.py

conventions.keys: Ed25519 seed = SHA-256('pv-aat02-analogues/' + name). Test keys only.
conventions.expected: The reference verifier's verdict and Section 8 step.

vectors.title: Every limit narrows at every hop
vectors.description: Scope, budget, argument values and depth each narrow from root to leaf.

vectors.title: Children keep their parent's limits unchanged
vectors.description: An equal budget, scope and value set is narrowing; depth still drops by one.

vectors.title: A root link alone
vectors.description: A one-link chain at depth 0, used inside its own limits.

vectors.title: Widened scope
vectors.description: Link 1 adds a tool its parent was not given.

vectors.title: Added argument value
vectors.description: Link 1 allows merchant M-999, which the parent's set does not contain.

vectors.title: Dropped argument constraint
vectors.description: Link 1 omits the parent's currency constraint.

vectors.title: Child constrains an argument its parent never named
vectors.description: Link 1 adds a region constraint. In PrivateVault an unnamed argument is free, so naming it narrows; in AAT an unnamed argument is denied, so naming it widens.

vectors.title: Argument no constraint names
vectors.description: The action passes a note argument that no link constrains.

vectors.title: Depth beyond the limit
vectors.description: Root limit 1: link 1 is terminal (remaining 0), so link 2 exceeds del_max_depth.

vectors.title: Child raises the depth limit
vectors.description: Link 1 keeps 2 remaining hops under a parent with 2: del_max_depth rises from 2 to 3.

vectors.title: Child drops the depth limit
vectors.description: Link 1 carries no depth limit under a parent with one.

vectors.title: A terminal root delegates
vectors.description: Root limit 0 is terminal; its child is refused.

vectors.title: Depth limit 3, four tokens
vectors.description: Root limit 3 and four links (depths 0..3).

vectors.title: Depth limit 3, five tokens
vectors.description: Root limit 3 and five links.

vectors.title: Depth limit 8, nine tokens
vectors.description: Root limit 8 and nine links (depths 0..8). AAT admits it; PrivateVault caps a chain at eight links, so it refuses before reading any limit.

vectors.title: Depth limit 8, eight tokens
vectors.description: Root limit 8 and eight links (depths 0..7).

vectors.title: Wrong par_hash
vectors.description: Link 1 names the root of a different chain held by the same agents.

vectors.title: Missing par_hash on a derived link
vectors.description: Link 1 carries no parent.

vectors.title: par_hash on the root
vectors.description: The root link names a parent.

vectors.title: Spliced link
vectors.description: Link 2 comes from a different chain whose agents match.

vectors.title: Reordered links
vectors.description: Links 1 and 2 swapped.

vectors.title: Replayed link
vectors.description: The same link presented twice in one chain.

vectors.title: Expired chain presented again
vectors.description: Presented at the root's expiry.

vectors.title: Forged signature
vectors.description: One hex digit of link 1's signature changed.

vectors.title: Signed with the wrong key
vectors.description: Link 1 says agent-1 delegated, but an unpinned key signed it.

vectors.title: Root not pinned
vectors.description: The root's delegator is not a trust anchor.

vectors.title: Field changed after signing
vectors.description: Link 1's budget lowered after it was signed: still narrower, but the signature no longer covers it.

vectors.title: Child outlives its parent
vectors.description: Link 1 expires ten minutes after the root.

vectors.title: Swapped constrained argument
vectors.description: Merchant M-102: the root allows it, link 1 narrowed it away.

vectors.title: Omitted constrained argument
vectors.description: No currency argument.

vectors.title: Tool outside the leaf's scope
vectors.description: The root allows payouts; the leaf does not.

vectors.title: Presented by an agent that is not the leaf
vectors.description: agent-2 presents the chain that ends at agent-3.
